description: Checks the domains connected to a site now: whether the TXT proves each is the person's, whether its A or CNAME sends it to Ploa, and whether a request reaches Ploa's hosting; with the records still to add and what's wrong. DNS changes usually show within minutes, sometimes hours; Ploa also checks by itself every few minutes. Read-only for the person's DNS.

domain.description: One domain to check (default: all of the site's).

site.description: The site's address (the part before .ploa.app) or ID. Needed when the workspace has more than one site.

name: ploa_web_domain_check
title: Check the site's domains
